messages:
Mia: rolling a new dev/stg bring-up for atlas-6b q8 in devstg-01. need quick smoke checklist run — can folks run the usual 10-15 sanity prompts and drop results here? focus: correctness, tokenization parity, and basic hallucination tests. ETA ~1h?
Sanjay: on it. will run seed set + a few adversarial prompts. will check p50/p95 latency too.
Kat: add multi-turn retention + instruction-following deterministic prompts. also check truncation behavior at 2048/8192 tokens.
Lisa: FYI I saw a weird escaped-quote issue on a prior q8 model (responses inserted extra backslashes). will include that as a test case.
Mia: good call @Kat @Lisa. include: 1) exact-match echo, 2) arithmetic + logic small items, 3) long context copy, 4) factual QA, 5) toxic content filter check. keep logs terse. :thumbsup:
Sanjay: running now. I'll paste quick summary + failures.
ci-bot: deploy to devstg-01 completed: atlas-6b-q8 @ revision r2026-11. runtime: 2xA10G.
deploy-bot: healthcheck passed (200/200).
Sanjay: quick report: 15 prompts. 12 passed, 3 flagged. Failures: one deterministic echo mutated punctuation, one math off-by-one, one added hallucinated citation. p50=78ms p95=210ms. payload size 512 tokens.
Kat: can you paste the failing prompt/responses (anonymized)?
Sanjay: sure — prompt: "Repeat exactly: \"Hello, world!\""
Sanjay: expected: "\"Hello, world!\""
Sanjay: got: "\\\"Hello, world!\\\""
Lisa: yep that's the backslash escaping issue I mentioned. looks like detokenize step added escapes.
Ori: probable cause: tokenizer->decoder mapping changed in q8 model export. run this quick check:
Ori: ```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t=Tokenizer.from_file('/models/atlas-6b-q8/tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('"Hello, world!"').ids)
print(t.decode(t.encode('"Hello, world!"').ids))
```
Ori: if decode adds extra slashes we know where to look.
Eva: also hit the hallucinated citation on factual QA: prompt: "Who wrote The Left Hand of Darkness?" expected: "Ursula K. Le Guin" got: "Ursula Le Guin (see DOI:10.1234/xyz)" — added fake DOI.
Kat: that's a quality regression vs baseline. mark for evals team. add to regression bucket with example and model revision.
Mia: agreed. Sanjay can you add failing cases to /evals/regressions/atlas6b/ and tag @evals?
Sanjay: done. uploaded minimal reproducer + model rev r2026-11. link: https://internal/redwood/evals/atlas6b/r2026-11
Lisa: tokenizer issue seems reproducible. quick mitigation: add post-detokenize replace of '\\"' -> '"' in our response sanitizer until we fix export. will open PR.
Mia: good temporary fix. for rollout decision: 1) blocker: hallucinated citations -> FAIL for canary; 2) escaping bug -> high priority but can be patched at serving layer.
Sanjay: latency looks fine for devstg but will run a 1k request batch to measure steady-state.
Kat: also check CPU fallback path; last time quant path spilled to CPU under certain seq lengths. add seq=8192 run.
ci-bot: scheduled job run: smoke-batch-1k starting in 10m (job id sb-1836000000).
Mia: thanks everyone. next steps: Sanjay runs the batch and posts results, Lisa opens sanitizer PR, Ori starts investigation on tokenizer export, Kat files regression ticket to evals. will reconvene here after smoke-batch. :eyes:
